timeQuestion: How much time should we allow for Sri Lanka?

questions.q: How do you shape a journey around us?
questions.a: We begin with your dates, interests, and pace. From there, we discuss a route and refine it with you.

questions.q: Can we make the trip work for children?
questions.a: Yes. We shorten the drives, keep safaris to one a day, and pick stays with room to spread out.

questions.q: What happens after we get in touch?
questions.a: You will hear from a travel designer, not a form reply. We talk first, then send a route for you to react to.

questions.q: Can the route change while we plan?
questions.a: Until the day you confirm, and in small ways after that. Nothing here is fixed before you are happy with it.

questions.q: What is included in a proposed trip?
questions.a: Accommodation, activities, meals as listed, and transfers with your driver. Flights and visas sit outside the plan.
